picks.title: How to shape your slides and videos with Gemini Notebook
picks.excerpt: Gemini Notebook is giving users more creative control over generated Slide Decks and Video Overviews, letting them co-create and steer the visual output rather than accept a one-shot result.
picks.rationale: First-party feature release that lets designers steer generated decks and video overviews instead of taking a one-shot result, so it is directly actionable for presentation work.

picks.title: Fal Debuts FLUX 3 Max Video Model Post-Trained With Black Forest Labs
picks.excerpt: fal announced FLUX 3 Max on October 19, a video generation model post-trained by fal Research with Black Forest Labs on the FLUX 3 foundation model, available the same day via fal's API for image-to-video work.
picks.rationale: New image-to-video model on the FLUX 3 base, available via API the same day. This is a separate release from the FLUX 3 Image launch on 10-03.

picks.title: New CG software you may have missed: 18 October 2026
picks.excerpt: Weekly roundup: NVIDIA's RTX video upscaling, frame generation and SDR-to-HDR now run locally as ComfyUI custom nodes (plus Krea 3, FLUX 3 Klein, Nano Banana 2.1 support); Maxon's Autograph adds an MCP server to drive it from Claude or ChatGPT, and Red Giant 2027 adds AI depth/normal-map relighting in After Effects.
picks.rationale: Concrete tool updates for motion and CG designers: an MCP server for Autograph, AI relighting in Red Giant 2027, and RTX nodes for ComfyUI. Copy should lead with these and leave out the Krea 3 and FLUX 3 Klein mentions, which were already published.

picks.title: Introducing WunderUI - the agentic design system
picks.excerpt: Design systems were built for humans who read docs, but much UI is now written by AI coding agents; WunderUI is pitched as a design system structured for agents to consume directly.
picks.rationale: A new design system built for AI coding agents to read, which fills the tokens/design-system slot. It is a product launch, not the 10-08 study of whether design systems change what agents write.

picks.title: AI-Edited Photos Can Lead People to Form False Memories
picks.excerpt: New research finds AI-edited photographs and videos create false memories and make people more confident in the wrong version of events, a warning for image-makers using generative edits.
picks.rationale: New research with an ethics angle for anyone shipping generative image edits. It comes from a fifth outlet and is not covered in history.
